chapter: CCC camp, field work and gambling
title: Picking berries on farms as a child
summary: As a child of six to nine he went by truck to farms across Louisiana to pick berries, hired at the street corner.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: When did you do the field work picking berries and stuff? Field work?

Yeah, that's when I was about six or seven, eight, nine years old. Where would you pick berries? I went through Hammond, Independent, Impostor Tool, Hall Bennett, Emet, Serento, Velma, Shiloh, Spencefield, Independent, Mopo, No showing off.
Well hey, who'd you work for then? This was when you were kids?
Well you were just working for people who were on the farms, you know.
Well they send trucks to pick you out there. How many hands they would need, they would come in and sit on the corner and ask for hands.
You mean somebody would drive a truck like in your neighborhood or something?

Well you didn't never know where the truck drivers come from either. I mean they would have to make a buck too. All they did would haul you there. And after that you may have never seen them no more. Their job was to get you to your designation. Uh huh. Wow.
